title: Korean Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew from Korea, made with tender beef and a variety of spices.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the beef broth, sugar, soy sauce, and gochujang, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-12 minutes.
Add the zucchini and simmer for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with green onions and toasted sesame seeds.
Serve with a side of rice or noodles, if desired.
